user.title: Connect to Proxmox Backup Server
user.description: Create an API token in PBS and grant it the matching ACL on the user *and* on the token itself.

data_description.token_id: Full token ID, for example ha@pbs!homeassistant
data_description.verify_ssl: Turn this off for the self-signed certificate PBS ships with.

datastores.title: Select datastores
datastores.description: Only the selected datastores get entities.

reauth_confirm.title: Renew the API token
reauth_confirm.description: Proxmox Backup Server on {host} rejected the stored token.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the host. Check address, port and whether TLS verification should be off.
error.invalid_auth: The token was rejected. Check the token ID and the secret.
error.insufficient_permissions: The token is valid but has no read access. Grant it DatastoreAdmin (or DatastoreAudit) on the datastore.
error.no_datastores: Authentication worked but no datastore is visible. PBS intersects user and token privileges, so the ACL must be set on both: once for ha@pbs and once for ha@pbs!homeassistant.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. See the Home Assistant log for details.

abort.already_configured: This Proxmox Backup Server is already set up.
abort.wrong_server: These credentials belong to a different Proxmox Backup Server.

data_description.allow_write: Enables garbage collection, verify, job runs and maintenance mode. Off by default.
data_description.allow_destructive: Enables prune and forget. These delete backups irreversibly.

error.destructive_needs_write: Destructive actions also require write actions to be allowed.
error.thresholds_out_of_order: The critical threshold must be higher than the warning threshold.
